Dear All,

Please accept this invitation for the Budget Sign-off Call for the above named opportunity.

 Approvers:

  • Sales / Account Management:  Add name

  • Project Leadership: Add name

Approvers – please ensure you identify a delegate/back-up if you cannot attend.

 Proposal Team

  • Approval of the budget (budget reflects delivery approach agreed to on Strategy Approval Call)

  • Are we able to deliver this study with the hours built in for the strategy and scope agreed? (Does Operations accept the budget)

Note: Budget approval is expected on the Sign-off Call, with email confirmation sent to the PD within 24 hours of the call. If budget approval is not received after 24 hours, we will consider the budget approved.

  • Resourcing Strategy (2 mins) - PL

  • Monitoring Strategy (2 mins) - Clinical DS&B

  • Overview of deal construct (3 mins) - SP

  • Budget overview: budget details, metrics, efficiencies (10 mins) - PD

  • Wrap up/actions for strategy lock (3 min) - PD

  • Is a MAP or SIM call required?

  • Should it be supplied centrally?
